faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, completely free. No sign-up, login, or app needed.
faq.a2: On Android and computers, files go to the Downloads folder. On iPhone and iPad (Safari), they are saved in the Files app → Downloads. From there you can save them to Photos with the Share button.
faq.q3: Why can't some videos be downloaded?
faq.a3: Private content, content that requires a login, or content restricted by region can't be reached by our server. Make sure the post is public, then try again.
faq.a4: After the link is processed, choose the MP3 option under Audio. The sound is taken from the video and converted to 192 kbps MP3.
faq.q5: Do TikTok videos have a watermark?
faq.a5: We always prefer the version without a watermark when it's available. Options that include a watermark are labeled Watermark.
faq.q6: Are my files stored on your server?
faq.a6: No. Files are sent from the original platform straight to your device and are not kept on our server.
